latest.headline: StoryVS_TTV Extends Unbeaten Run with Perfect Croatia Performance
latest.paragraph: StoryVS_TTV continued their flawless start to Season 5 by securing another commanding victory in Croatia. The Hyundai i20 N Rally2 driver was untouchable across all seven stages, marking a perfect weekend that keeps their winning streak alive. GTI_1990 maintained consistent pace to claim second place overall, finishing forty-four seconds behind the leader. Meanwhile, Tuinboon27 rounded out the podium despite a five-second penalty on stage four. With thirty points added to their tally, StoryVS_TTV further solidified their standing at the top of the leaderboard after yet another display of absolute dominance.
